import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mod1 = 998244353L;
    static final long mod2 = 1000000007L;
    static final long[] pw = {1L, 10L, 100L, 1000L, 10000L, 100000L, 1000000L};
    static long[] s = new long[7];
    static long ans = 0;
    static long cnt1 = 0;
    static long n;
    static long cnt2 = 0;
    static List<Long>[] v = new ArrayList[7];

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            v[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        dfs1(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(v[i]);
        }
        cnt2 = -1;
        dfs2(0, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void dfs1(int k1, long k2) {
        if (k1 == 7) return;
        v[k1].add((cnt1 - k2 + mod1) % mod1);
        s[k1] += (cnt1 - k2 + mod1) % mod1;
        cnt1++;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs1(k1 + 1, k2 * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static boolean check(long x) {
        return x * pw[6] + 999999 <= n && x * pw[6] * 10 > n;
    }

    static void dfs2(int k1, long k2) {
        if (k2 > n) return;
        if (check(k2)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long p = ((cnt2 + 1 - (k2 * pw[i])) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1;
                int w = lowerBound(v[i], mod1 - p);
                ans = (ans + (s[i] + p * v[i].size() - mod1 * (v[i].size() - w))) % mod2;
            }
            cnt2 += cnt1;
            return;
        }
        cnt2++;
        ans = (ans + ((cnt2 - k2) % mod1 + mod1) % mod1) % mod2;
        for (int i = (k1 == 0 ? 0 : 0); i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs2(k1 + 1, k2 * 10 + i);
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
